Subject: POC kickoff and hands-on lab — initial availability

Hi Diego / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the performance numbers. We're ready to kick off the hands-on POC so we can validate prompt routing and run a short load profile.

High-level asks:
- 2 hour hands-on session to run prompt review, routing scenarios, and light load tests (50–200 concurrent sessions simulated)
- Introductions to your delivery lead and whoever will support the KV/prefix caching and batching config
- Shared success criteria: response latency under 400ms p50 for small prompts, stable throughput for 100 concurrent requests, and end-to-end tracing available in the console

Who should attend from your side? Our stakeholders: Tom (platform), myself (product), and two engineers (I'll confirm names after we lock a slot).

Availability windows (PST):
- Tue 18 Aug: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 19 Aug: morning only

Can you confirm a preferred slot and send a calendar invite with a short agenda? Also please attach any prep materials (load template, agenda).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Product, Integrations — Acme Financial

2) 30m prompt review & routing demo (prefix/KV cache walkthrough)
3) 60m hands-on load tests (we'll orchestrate simulated traffic using the template)
4) 20m observations, next steps, mutual action plan

Attachments: POC_Kickstart_Agenda_v2.pdf; Load_Test_Template.csv; Mutual_Action_Plan_acme42.docx
